```{python}
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import display, Markdown

df = pd.read_csv("data.csv")
numeric = df.select_dtypes(include="number")
time_columns = [c for c in df.columns if any(token in c.lower() for token in ("date", "time", "year", "period"))]
display(Markdown(f"<div class='summary-grid'><div class='summary-card'><span class='label'>Rows</span><span class='value'>{len(df):,}</span></div><div class='summary-card'><span class='label'>Columns</span><span class='value'>{len(df.columns)}</span></div><div class='summary-card'><span class='label'>Numeric measures</span><span class='value'>{len(numeric)}</span></div></div>\n\n**Input:** `{SOURCE_FILENAME}`"))
```

## Research view

This report describes the uploaded table without imposing an IDD-specific schema. It shows the observed fields, distributions, missingness, and—when a date or period field is present—how numeric measures vary over time.

## Data quality overview

```{python}
quality = pd.DataFrame({
    "column": df.columns,
    "type": [str(df[c].dtype) for c in df.columns],
    "missing": [int(df[c].isna().sum()) for c in df.columns],
    "distinct_values": [int(df[c].nunique(dropna=True)) for c in df.columns],
})
display(quality)
```

## Numeric measures

```{python}
if numeric.empty:
    display(Markdown("No numeric measures were detected."))
else:
    display(numeric.describe().transpose().round(3))
```

## Time structure

```{python}
if not time_columns:
    display(Markdown("No time or period column was detected. This is treated as a snapshot."))
else:
    display(Markdown("Detected time-like column(s): " + ", ".join(f"`{c}`" for c in time_columns)))
    for column in time_columns:
        parsed = pd.to_datetime(df[column], errors="coerce")
        if parsed.notna().mean() >= 0.8:
            display(df.assign(_time=parsed).groupby("_time")[list(numeric.columns)].sum().tail(20) if not numeric.empty else df[column].value_counts().head(20))
```

## Data preview

```{python}
display(df.head(20))
```

## Reproducibility note

The uploaded file, generated summary, provenance record, and this editable Quarto source are stored together in the run directory. The report is descriptive only; it does not infer causality or apply IDD disease classifications.
